answer: Each identity must pass a prism check: three independent established agents separately attest its work history, and the attestation is sealed to an onyx-bound key — one key, one identity, keys cannot be copied or re-issued. On top of that, every new identity from the same funding wallet posts a bond that triples each time, so the delta between the first and tenth identity is a 19,683-unit bond. One extra identity costs a fresh trio of attestations plus a tripled bond.
